pages.title: Pottery Basics
pages.text: Pottery is essential for making crucibles, molds, and other ceramic tools.$(br2)The process involves multiple steps: gathering clay, shaping greenware, building a kiln, and firing.$(br2)For a complete guide, read the §3Pit Kiln Firing Guide§r (obtainable separately).

pages.title: Step 1: Gather Raw Materials
pages.text: $(li)Use §6Flint Shovel§r on sand/gravel to get §6Raw Clay§r$(br)$(li)Use §6Flint Knife§r on grass to get §6Grass Fiber§r$(br)$(li)Harvest wheat for §6Rice Husk§r (30% chance)$(br2)These are the basic materials for pottery.

pages.title: Step 2: Make Greenware
pages.text: Combine raw clay with temper (grog) and fiber to make mixed clay. Then shape it into greenware:$(br2)$(li)§6Crucible§r - for melting metals$(br)$(li)§6Mold§r - for casting shapes$(br)$(li)§6Brick§r - for construction$(br)$(li)§6Blowpipe§r - for metalworking$(br2)Greenware must be fired in a kiln to become usable.

pages.title: Step 3: Build and Fire Kiln
pages.text: $(li)Use §6Flint Shovel§r on dirt to dig a kiln pit$(br)$(li)Place greenware items in the kiln$(br)$(li)Add fuel through the fire mouth$(br)$(li)Seal with kiln lid and ignite$(br)$(li)Control temperature and atmosphere$(br)$(li)Wait for firing to complete, then collect$(br2)§6Tip:§r Different products need different firing conditions.
